events.facts: Cagey opening; both teams compact; few risks.
Mercer heads narrowly wide from Rowan's cross.
Venn scores after Kingsport break quickly through the centre; assist Luca Dane.
Northbridge begin creating repeated overloads on their right side.
Rook makes a strong save from Leon Vale after a cut-back.
Vale equalises from Malik Rowan's low cross after sustained right-side pressure.
Mercer scores, but VAR checks offside in the build-up.
Goal disallowed for a marginal offside. Score remains 1-1.
Cole booked for stopping Andre Solis during a transition.
Arden misses a clear chance from eight metres.
Dane scores from the edge of the area after Northbridge fail to clear a second ball.
Kian Holt replaces Jalen Pike; Northbridge reshape to create greater width and repeated one-against-one situations on the right.
Holt stays wide and repeatedly isolates Kingsport's left-back.
Vale goes down under contact; VAR checks but no penalty is awarded.
Cole receives a second yellow for a late challenge; Kingsport reduced to ten.
Rowan equalises from Kian Holt's cross after Northbridge exploit the right side.
Rook saves from Andre Solis to keep the score level.
Vale scores the winner from another Holt delivery after Kingsport are stretched on their left.
Arlen heads over from Kingsport's final set piece.
Northbridge win 3-2 after trailing 2-1; their right-side change and Kingsport red card shape the comeback.

Fresh creativity for the final push.
Fresh outlet for the final minutes.
Defensive cover while Northbridge chase and then protect the late result.

es.E01: Apertura cautelosa; ambos equipos compactos; pocos riesgos.
es.E02: Mercer cabecea ligeramente desviado tras el centro de Rowan.
es.E03: Venn marca tras un rápido contraataque de Kingsport por el centro; asistencia de Luca Dane.
es.E04: Northbridge comienza a crear sobrecargas repetidas en su lado derecho.
es.E05: Rook realiza una gran parada a Leon Vale tras un pase atrás.
es.E06: Vale iguala tras un centro bajo de Malik Rowan después de una presión sostenida por el lado derecho.
es.E07: Mercer marca, pero el VAR revisa un fuera de juego en la jugada previa.
es.E08: Gol anulado por un fuera de juego marginal. El marcador sigue 1-1.
es.E09: Cole amonestado por detener a Andre Solis durante una transición.
es.E10: Arden falla una clara oportunidad desde ocho metros.
es.E11: Dane marca desde el borde del área tras un segundo balón que Northbridge no despeja.
es.E12: Kian Holt entra por Jalen Pike; Northbridge se reorganiza para crear mayor amplitud y situaciones repetidas de uno contra uno por la derecha.
es.E13: Holt se mantiene abierto y aísla repetidamente al lateral izquierdo de Kingsport.
es.E14: Vale cae tras un contacto; el VAR revisa pero no se concede penalti.
es.E15: Cole recibe una segunda amarilla por una entrada tardía; Kingsport queda con diez.
es.E16: Rowan iguala tras un centro de Kian Holt después de que Northbridge explote el lado derecho.
es.E17: Rook detiene un disparo de Andre Solis y mantiene el empate.
es.E18: Vale marca el gol de la victoria tras otro centro de Holt después de que Kingsport quede expuesto por la izquierda.
es.E19: Arlen cabecea por encima en el último balón parado de Kingsport.
es.E20: Northbridge gana 3-2 tras ir perdiendo 2-1; el cambio por la derecha y la tarjeta roja a Kingsport marcan la remontada.

fr.E01: Début prudent ; les deux équipes compactes ; peu de risques.
fr.E02: Mercer manque de peu le cadre de la tête sur un centre de Rowan.
fr.E03: Venn marque après une contre-attaque rapide de Kingsport par le centre ; passe décisive de Luca Dane.
fr.E04: Northbridge commence à créer des surcharges répétées sur leur côté droit.
fr.E05: Rook réalise un arrêt solide sur Leon Vale après un centre en retrait.
fr.E06: Vale égalise sur un centre bas de Malik Rowan après une pression soutenue sur le côté droit.
fr.E07: Mercer marque, mais le VAR vérifie un hors-jeu dans la construction de l’action.
fr.E08: But refusé pour un hors-jeu marginal. Le score reste 1-1.
fr.E09: Cole reçoit un carton jaune pour avoir stoppé Andre Solis lors d'une transition.
fr.E10: Arden manque une occasion claire à huit mètres.
fr.E11: Dane marque depuis le bord de la surface après que Northbridge n'a pas dégagé un second ballon.
fr.E12: Kian Holt remplace Jalen Pike ; Northbridge se réorganise pour créer plus de largeur et des situations répétées de un contre un sur la droite.
fr.E13: Holt reste large et isole à plusieurs reprises le latéral gauche de Kingsport.
fr.E14: Vale tombe sous un contact ; le VAR vérifie mais aucun penalty n'est accordé.
fr.E15: Cole reçoit un second carton jaune pour un tacle tardif ; Kingsport réduit à dix.
fr.E16: Rowan égalise sur un centre de Kian Holt après que Northbridge a exploité le côté droit.
fr.E17: Rook arrête un tir d'Andre Solis pour maintenir le score à égalité.
fr.E18: Vale marque le but de la victoire sur une autre passe de Holt après que Kingsport a été étiré sur leur gauche.
fr.E19: Arlen place sa tête au-dessus sur le dernier coup de pied arrêté de Kingsport.
fr.E20: Northbridge l'emporte 3-2 après avoir été mené 2-1 ; leur changement sur le côté droit et le carton rouge de Kingsport façonnent la remontée.

de.E01: Vorsichtiger Beginn; beide Teams kompakt; wenige Risiken.
de.E02: Mercer köpft knapp am Tor vorbei nach Rowans Flanke.
de.E03: Venn trifft, nachdem Kingsport schnell durch die Mitte kontert; Vorlage Luca Dane.
de.E04: Northbridge beginnt, wiederholt Überzahlsituationen auf ihrer rechten Seite zu schaffen.
de.E05: Rook pariert stark gegen Leon Vale nach einem Zuspiel in den Rückraum.
de.E06: Vale gleicht nach einer flachen Hereingabe von Malik Rowan aus, nach anhaltendem Druck über die rechte Seite.
de.E07: Mercer trifft, aber der VAR überprüft eine Abseitsstellung im Aufbau.
de.E08: Tor wegen marginaler Abseitsstellung aberkannt. Spielstand bleibt 1-1.
de.E09: Cole wird verwarnt, weil er Andre Solis während eines Umschaltmoments stoppt.
de.E10: Arden vergibt eine klare Chance aus acht Metern.
de.E11: Dane trifft vom Strafraumeck, nachdem Northbridge einen zweiten Ball nicht klären konnte.
de.E12: Kian Holt kommt für Jalen Pike; Northbridge formieren um, um mehr Breite und wiederholte Eins-gegen-eins-Situationen auf der rechten Seite zu schaffen.
de.E13: Holt bleibt breit und isoliert wiederholt Kingsports linken Außenverteidiger.
de.E14: Vale geht nach Kontakt zu Boden; VAR prüft, aber kein Elfmeter wird gegeben.
de.E15: Cole erhält die zweite Gelbe Karte für ein spätes Foul; Kingsport ist nur noch zu zehnt.
de.E16: Rowan gleicht aus nach einer Flanke von Kian Holt, nachdem Northbridge die rechte Seite ausnutzt.
de.E17: Rook pariert gegen Andre Solis und hält den Spielstand.
de.E18: Vale erzielt den Siegtreffer nach einer weiteren Flanke von Holt, nachdem Kingsport auf der linken Seite offen ist.
de.E19: Arlen köpft nach Kingsports letztem Standard über das Tor.
de.E20: Northbridge gewinnt 3-2 nach einem 1-2-Rückstand; die Umstellung auf der rechten Seite und Kingsports Rote Karte prägen die Aufholjagd.

Tash.E01: Cagey start. Both sides are compact and neither is committing many players forward yet.
Tash.E02: First real warning. Rowan finds space to cross and Mercer attacks the area well, but the header drifts wide.
Tash.E03: GOAL - Kingsport lead 1-0. One vertical pass removes the midfield and Dane releases Venn before Northbridge can recover. Excellent transition.
Tash.E04: Northbridge are beginning to create an overload on their right. Kingsport's left side is being pulled wider with every attack.
Tash.E05: Excellent save from Rook, but the cut-back is the key detail. Northbridge have found that right-side route again.
Tash.E06: GOAL - 1-1. The pattern finally pays off. Rowan gets free on the right, delivers low and Vale arrives at exactly the right moment.
Tash.E07: Mercer has the ball in the net, but VAR is checking his position in the build-up. This looks extremely tight.
Tash.E08: NO GOAL. Mercer is marginally offside in the build-up, so it stays 1-1.
Tash.E09: Cole is booked for stopping Solis in transition. That yellow may affect how aggressively he can defend the central space now.
Tash.E10: That is a major miss. Arden finds the space and receives the ball eight metres out; the finish has to be on target.
Tash.E11: GOAL - Kingsport lead 2-1. Northbridge never clear the second ball and Dane punishes them from the edge of the area.
Tash.E12: Holt comes on and Northbridge immediately move wider. This is an aggressive change designed to isolate Kingsport's left-back.
Tash.E13: The change is working. Holt is holding the width and Kingsport's left-back is repeatedly being left one against one.
Tash.E14: No penalty after the review. There is contact on Vale, but not enough evidence to overturn the on-field decision.
Tash.E15: RED CARD. Cole receives a second yellow and Kingsport are down to ten. Protecting the central areas becomes the immediate priority.
Tash.E16: GOAL - 2-2. There it is again. Holt holds the width, creates the crossing angle and Rowan attacks the space. The substitution has transformed the game.
Tash.E17: Outstanding save from Rook. Solis finds the gap, but the goalkeeper keeps Kingsport level.
Tash.E18: GOAL - Northbridge lead 3-2. The right-side change has decided this match. Holt stays wide, Kingsport are stretched and Vale attacks the delivery. The winner is late; the warning signs were not.
Tash.E19: One final chance for Kingsport, but Arlen heads over. That may be the last opportunity.
Tash.E20: FULL TIME - Northbridge win 3-2. The decisive change was Holt's introduction: his width repeatedly exposed Kingsport's left side, and the red card made that problem even harder to solve.

Jay.E01: Pretty cautious so far. Neither side wants to give much away.
Jay.E02: Good chance. Mercer gets there first but cannot keep the header on target.
Jay.E03: GOAL! Kingsport lead 1-0. Quick, simple and ruthless on the break.
Jay.E04: Northbridge are getting more joy down the right now. Kingsport need to deal with it.
Jay.E05: Top save from Rook. Northbridge are knocking on the door now.
Jay.E06: GOAL! 1-1. That has been coming, and again it comes from the right-hand side.
Jay.E07: Mercer thinks he has made it 2-1, but VAR are checking offside.
Jay.E08: No goal. Very tight, but Mercer has gone a fraction too early.
Jay.E09: Yellow for Cole. He had to stop the break, but he is on a warning now.
Jay.E10: Arden has to score that. Huge chance for Kingsport.
Jay.E11: GOAL! Kingsport are back in front. Northbridge had chances to clear it and did not.
Jay.E12: Holt is on. Looks like Northbridge want more width and more direct running.
Jay.E13: Northbridge are getting in down that side again. Holt has changed the feel of the game.
Jay.E14: No penalty. There is contact, but I can understand why they have stayed with the original call.
Jay.E15: Cole is off. Second yellow, and Kingsport have a difficult final ten minutes ahead.
Jay.E16: GOAL! 2-2. Holt creates it from the right and Rowan finishes it. That change has made a huge difference.
Jay.E17: What a save from Rook. That looked like the winner.
Jay.E18: GOAL! 3-2 Northbridge! They have turned it around. Kingsport have not dealt with that right side since Holt came on.
Jay.E19: Arlen gets the final chance and puts it over. That could be it.
Jay.E20: FULL TIME - 3-2 Northbridge. Great comeback. Holt changed the game, Kingsport lost Cole, and Northbridge took advantage.

Dave.E01: Three minutes in and everyone is still introducing themselves.
Dave.E02: That was the first proper chance. Mercer will want that header back.
Dave.E03: Kingsport strike first. Northbridge lost the ball and suddenly Venn had half the pitch to himself.
Dave.E04: Kingsport's left side is starting to look very available.
Dave.E05: Rook has just kept Kingsport in front. Northbridge are getting closer.
Dave.E06: There it is. Northbridge kept going down that side and Vale finally makes it count.
Dave.E07: The celebration is on hold. VAR has entered the conversation.
Dave.E08: Ruled out. That is a long celebration to have to take back.
Dave.E09: Cole takes the yellow and ends the counter. Sensible until he has to defend the next hour on it.
Dave.E10: That is a serious let-off for Northbridge. Arden had most of the goal to aim at.
Dave.E11: Kingsport lead again. Northbridge cleared everything except the actual danger.
Dave.E12: Holt is on and he has been told one thing: stay wide and cause problems.
Dave.E13: That left-back has had no peace since Holt came on.
Dave.E14: No penalty. The debate can continue; the score cannot.
Dave.E15: Cole is gone. Kingsport now have ten men and a very long final stretch.
Dave.E16: Two-two. Holt has been causing trouble since he walked on and now Kingsport have paid for it.
Dave.E17: Rook says not yet. Northbridge were already halfway into the celebration.
Dave.E18: Northbridge have actually done it. Ninety-three minutes, 3-2, and once again it comes from the side Kingsport never managed to close.
Dave.E19: Arlen had one last look at goal. Over the bar. Northbridge can almost touch the finish line.
Dave.E20: FULL TIME - 3-2. Northbridge were behind, changed the game from the right and finished with a ninety-third-minute winner. That is football doing what football does.
